\section[\texorpdfstring{\bn{উৎপাদন} (utpādôn)}{উৎপাদন (utpādôn)}]{\bn{উৎপাদন} (utpādôn) — production; output}

\label{lesson:BN-C499-utpadon}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Bengali for a business partner, then the Bengali for a company share.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \bn{উৎপাদন}}
\textbf{\bn{উৎপাদন}} — \emph{utpādôn} — \textquotedblleft{}production; output\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\bn{এই} \bn{কারখানা} \bn{রোজ} \bn{এক} \bn{হাজার} \bn{জুতো} \bn{উৎপাদন} \bn{করে।}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{Ei kārkhānā roj ek hājār juto utpādôn kôre.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
This factory produces a thousand shoes a day.
\end{quote}

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\bn{উৎপাদন}} (\emph{utpādôn}) is a tatsama, Sanskrit \emph{utpādana}, \textquotedblleft{}bringing forth, producing\textquotedblright{} (Monier-Williams).
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for describing what you lived and felt.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{utpādôn}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{utpādôn}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{Ei kārkhānā roj ek hājār juto utpādôn kôre.} — This factory produces a thousand shoes a day.
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Bengali for a business partner, then the Bengali for a company share, then say \emph{utpādôn} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
What does \bn{উৎপাদন} mean? (\textquotedblleft{}Production; output\textquotedblright{}.) Say it once more.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[\texorpdfstring{\bn{কাঁচামাল} (kā̃chāmāl)}{কাঁচামাল (kā̃chāmāl)}]{\bn{কাঁচামাল} (kā̃chāmāl) — raw material}

\label{lesson:BN-C499-kachamal}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Bengali for a company share, then the Bengali for production.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \bn{কাঁচামাল}}
\textbf{\bn{কাঁচামাল}} — \emph{kā̃chāmāl} — \textquotedblleft{}raw material\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\bn{কাঁচামাল} \bn{না} \bn{এলে} \bn{কারখানা} \bn{থামবে।}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{Kā̃chāmāl nā ele kārkhānā thāmbe.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
If the raw material doesn't arrive, the factory will stop.
\end{quote}

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\bn{কাঁচামাল}} (\emph{kā̃chāmāl}) joins \bn{কাঁচা}, \textquotedblleft{}raw\textquotedblright{}, to \bn{মাল}, \textquotedblleft{}goods\textquotedblright{}, which is usually traced to Arabic \emph{māl}, \textquotedblleft{}property\textquotedblright{}.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for describing what you lived and felt.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{kā̃chāmāl}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{kā̃chāmāl}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{Kā̃chāmāl nā ele kārkhānā thāmbe.} — If the raw material doesn't arrive, the factory will stop.
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Bengali for a company share, then the Bengali for production, then say \emph{kā̃chāmāl} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
What does \bn{কাঁচামাল} mean? (\textquotedblleft{}Raw material\textquotedblright{}.) Say it once more.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[\texorpdfstring{\bn{রপ্তানি} \bn{করা} (rôptāni kôrā)}{রপ্তানি করা (rôptāni kôrā)}]{\bn{রপ্তানি} \bn{করা} (rôptāni kôrā) — to export}

\label{lesson:BN-C499-roptani-kora}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Bengali for production, then the Bengali for raw material.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \bn{রপ্তানি} \bn{করা}}
\textbf{\bn{রপ্তানি} \bn{করা}} — \emph{rôptāni kôrā} — \textquotedblleft{}to export\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\bn{এই} \bn{কারখানা} \bn{বিদেশে} \bn{জামা} \bn{রপ্তানি} \bn{করে।}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{Ei kārkhānā bideshe jāmā rôptāni kôre.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
This factory exports shirts abroad.
\end{quote}

Past (he/she …): \bn{তিনি} \bn{বিদেশে} \bn{চা} \bn{রপ্তানি} \bn{করলেন}, \emph{tini bideshe chā rôptāni kôrlen}.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\bn{রপ্তানি} \bn{করা}} (\emph{rôptāni kôrā}) joins \bn{রপ্তানি}, \textquotedblleft{}export\textquotedblright{}, usually traced to Persian \emph{raftanī}, \textquotedblleft{}what is to go out\textquotedblright{}, to \bn{করা}, \textquotedblleft{}to do\textquotedblright{}.

  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Bengali for production, then the Bengali for raw material, then say \emph{rôptāni kôrā} again

\section[\texorpdfstring{\bn{সরবরাহ} (sôrbôrāh)}{সরবরাহ (sôrbôrāh)}]{\bn{সরবরাহ} (sôrbôrāh) — a supply; supplying}

\label{lesson:BN-C499-sorborah}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Bengali for raw material, then the Bengali for to export.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \bn{সরবরাহ}}
\textbf{\bn{সরবরাহ}} — \emph{sôrbôrāh} — \textquotedblleft{}a supply; supplying\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\bn{বন্যার} \bn{পরে} \bn{গ্রামে} \bn{খাবারের} \bn{সরবরাহ} \bn{থামল।}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{Bônyār pôre grāme khābārer sôrbôrāh thāmlô.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
After the flood the food supply to the village stopped.
\end{quote}

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\bn{সরবরাহ}} (\emph{sôrbôrāh}) is usually traced to Persian \emph{sarbarāh}, \textquotedblleft{}management, provision\textquotedblright{}.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for describing what you lived and felt.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{sôrbôrāh}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{sôrbôrāh}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{Bônyār pôre grāme khābārer sôrbôrāh thāmlô.} — After the flood the food supply to the village stopped.
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Bengali for raw material, then the Bengali for to export, then say \emph{sôrbôrāh} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
What does \bn{সরবরাহ} mean? (\textquotedblleft{}A supply; supplying\textquotedblright{}.) Say it once more.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[\texorpdfstring{\bn{আমদানি} (āmdāni)}{আমদানি (āmdāni)}]{\bn{আমদানি} (āmdāni) — an import; imports}

\label{lesson:BN-C499-amdani}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Bengali for to export, then the Bengali for a supply.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \bn{আমদানি}}
\textbf{\bn{আমদানি}} — \emph{āmdāni} — \textquotedblleft{}an import; imports\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\bn{আমাদের} \bn{দেশে} \bn{তেলের} \bn{আমদানি} \bn{বাড়ল।}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{Āmāder deshe teler āmdāni bāṛlô.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
Our country's oil imports went up.
\end{quote}

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\bn{আমদানি}} (\emph{āmdāni}) is usually traced to Persian \emph{āmadanī}, \textquotedblleft{}what is to come in\textquotedblright{}: the partner of \bn{রপ্তানি}.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for describing what you lived and felt.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{āmdāni}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{āmdāni}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{Āmāder deshe teler āmdāni bāṛlô.} — Our country's oil imports went up.
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Bengali for to export, then the Bengali for a supply, then say \emph{āmdāni} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
What does \bn{আমদানি} mean? (\textquotedblleft{}An import; imports\textquotedblright{}.) Say it once more.

\section[(dialogue)]{Looking back: from Skilled Hands to Goods and Supplies}

\label{lesson:BN-R499-review-492-499}



\begin{quote}
Say the Bengali for a craftsman and a goldsmith.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item a craftsman, a goldsmith, to solder, a bell-metal smith, to string together
  \item a desk, a clerk, an official seal, an office messenger, to type
  \item unemployed, a CV, an apprentice, a job interview, to join a job
  \item pay, a bonus, earnings, a pension, to be worth it
  \item a post at work, a promotion, an assistant, senior in rank, to stay in post
  \item a resignation, a job transfer, a strike by workers, dismissed, to lay off
  \item an initiative, a line of business, capital, a business partner, a company share
  \item production, raw material, to export, a supply, imports
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
A craftsman? (\textbf{\bn{কারিগর}}, \emph{kārigôr}.) A goldsmith? (\textbf{\bn{স্যাকরা}}, \emph{sækrā}.) To solder? (\textbf{\bn{ঝালাই} \bn{করা}}, \emph{jhālāi kôrā}.) A bell-metal smith? (\textbf{\bn{কাঁসারি}}, \emph{kā̃sāri}.) To string together? (\textbf{\bn{গাঁথা}}, \emph{gā̃thā}.) A desk? (\textbf{\bn{ডেস্ক}}, \emph{ḍesk}.) A clerk? (\textbf{\bn{কেরানি}}, \emph{kerāni}.) An official seal? (\textbf{\bn{সিলমোহর}}, \emph{silmohôr}.) An office messenger? (\textbf{\bn{পিওন}}, \emph{pion}.) To type? (\textbf{\bn{টাইপ} \bn{করা}}, \emph{ṭāip kôrā}.) Unemployed? (\textbf{\bn{বেকার}}, \emph{bekār}.) A CV? (\textbf{\bn{বায়োডাটা}}, \emph{bāyoḍāṭā}.) An apprentice? (\textbf{\bn{শিক্ষানবিশ}}, \emph{shikkhānôbish}.) A job interview? (\textbf{\bn{ইন্টারভিউ}}, \emph{inṭārbhiu}.) To join a job? (\textbf{\bn{যোগ} \bn{দেওয়া}}, \emph{jog deoyā}.) Pay? (\textbf{\bn{বেতন}}, \emph{betôn}.) A bonus? (\textbf{\bn{বোনাস}}, \emph{bonās}.) Earnings? (\textbf{\bn{উপার্জন}}, \emph{upārjôn}.) A pension? (\textbf{\bn{পেনশন}}, \emph{penshôn}.) To be worth it? (\textbf{\bn{পোষানো}}, \emph{poshāno}.) A post at work? (\textbf{\bn{পদ}}, \emph{pôd}.) A promotion? (\textbf{\bn{পদোন্নতি}}, \emph{pôdonnôti}.) An assistant? (\textbf{\bn{সহকারী}}, \emph{sôhôkārī}.) Senior in rank? (\textbf{\bn{সিনিয়র}}, \emph{siniyôr}.) To stay in post? (\textbf{\bn{বহাল} \bn{থাকা}}, \emph{bôhāl thākā}.) A resignation? (\textbf{\bn{ইস্তফা}}, \emph{istôphā}.) A job transfer? (\textbf{\bn{বদলি}}, \emph{bôdli}.) A strike by workers? (\textbf{\bn{ধর্মঘট}}, \emph{dhôrmôghôṭ}.) Dismissed? (\textbf{\bn{বরখাস্ত}}, \emph{bôrkhāstô}.) To lay off? (\textbf{\bn{ছাঁটাই} \bn{করা}}, \emph{chhā̃ṭāi kôrā}.) An initiative? (\textbf{\bn{উদ্যোগ}}, \emph{udyog}.) A line of business? (\textbf{\bn{কারবার}}, \emph{kārbār}.) Capital? (\textbf{\bn{পুঁজি}}, \emph{pũji}.) A business partner? (\textbf{\bn{অংশীদার}}, \emph{ôngshīdār}.) A company share? (\textbf{\bn{শেয়ার}}, \emph{sheyār}.) Production? (\textbf{\bn{উৎপাদন}}, \emph{utpādôn}.) Raw material? (\textbf{\bn{কাঁচামাল}}, \emph{kā̃chāmāl}.) To export? (\textbf{\bn{রপ্তানি} \bn{করা}}, \emph{rôptāni kôrā}.) A supply? (\textbf{\bn{সরবরাহ}}, \emph{sôrbôrāh}.) Imports? (\textbf{\bn{আমদানি}}, \emph{āmdāni}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
